title: US State Quality of Life Index Map
description: Interactive choropleth map grading all 50 US states on 8 quality of life metrics including income, education, health, crime, and housing costs.
subject: Mathematics
topic: US State Quality of Life Index Map
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Interpret a choropleth map by relating each state's color from dark green to dark red to its count of metrics better than the national average
Identify the eight quality of life metrics used, including cost-of-living-adjusted personal income, poverty rate, education attainment, life expectancy, and infant mortality
Calculate a state's grade out of 8 by comparing each of its metric values against the national average
Distinguish metrics where higher values are better, such as life expectancy, from metrics where lower values are better, such as infant mortality and poverty rate
Evaluate the limits of collapsing eight distinct measures into a single composite index
